skill.name: buddy-sings
skill.description: Generates an original song for a Claude Code buddy using the buddy profile, localized lyrics, MiniMax music generation, and local playback.
skill.summary: Create original, localized songs for a Claude Code buddy with a consistent generated voice.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: The skill has useful creative functionality, but it performs sensitive local context collection and sends generated prompts or lyrics to an external MiniMax service. Most static command findings are Markdown false positives, while the confirmed issues center on hidden Claude memory access, external CLI generation, and shell argument handling.

remediation.issue: Automatic scanning of Claude memory, conversation context, and git history can collect private data.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit confirmation before each context source is read, show the source list, and provide a no-memory mode.

remediation.issue: Personal context may be sent to MiniMax during music generation.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy warning before generation and redact secrets or sensitive names from prompts and lyrics by default.

remediation.issue: Shell command examples interpolate prompt, lyrics, and file-name placeholders.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke the mmx CLI with structured argument arrays or strict shell escaping, and sanitize pet names before using them in paths.

remediation.issue: The skill reads hidden Claude configuration files.
remediation.suggestion: Limit reads to the exact companion field, document the access clearly, and avoid reading unrelated keys from configuration files.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Private Context Collection
semantic_findings.description: The skill infers when personal context is needed, then automatically scans conversation context, memory files, and git history before building lyrics. This can collect private user and project details without a dedicated consent step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly say to automatically scan context sources and use gathered context to enrich lyrics. The evidence is direct and repeated.

semantic_findings.title: External Disclosure of Personal Song Context
semantic_findings.description: The skill sends the final prompt and lyrics to MiniMax through the mmx music generation command. If memory or session details are included, private context leaves the local environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow states that gathered context enriches the lyrics prompt and that an API prompt is used for generation. The mmx commands provide the external transfer path.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped Shell Argument Construction
semantic_findings.description: The command examples interpolate generated prompts, lyrics, and pet names into shell arguments. If an agent executes these examples through a shell without robust escaping, crafted content could alter the command.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples use quoted placeholders for prompt, lyrics, and output name rather than a structured argument array. Exploitability depends on the executor, so confidence is high enough to retain but not absolute.

content.user_title: Create Songs for Your Claude Code Buddy
content.value_statement: Users want playful pet songs without designing voices, lyrics, prompts, and playback steps. This skill turns a Claude Code buddy profile into generated music with consistent vocal identity.
actual_capabilities: Reads the Claude buddy companion profile to find the pet name and personality.
Creates and caches a consistent vocal identity for the same pet.
Builds original lyrics and a music prompt based on the requested theme.
Can gather session, memory, and git context when the song asks for personal details.
Uses the mmx CLI to generate an MP3 file with MiniMax music generation.
Attempts local playback with mpv, ffplay, or afplay when available.
limitations: Requires the mmx CLI, a MiniMax API key, and network access for generation.
May read local Claude configuration and memory files when personal context is requested.
Sends the final music prompt and lyrics to the MiniMax service.
Playback depends on an installed local audio player.

use_cases.title: Personal Pet Songs
use_cases.description: Turn a Claude Code buddy personality into a custom song for fun sessions or small celebrations.

use_cases.title: Creative Song Drafts
use_cases.description: Generate a themed lyric and music direction from a pet voice before refining the result manually.

use_cases.title: Workday Recaps
use_cases.description: Use recent session or git context to create a light song about completed work.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Theme Song
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a clear theme.
prompt_templates.prompt: Let my Claude Code buddy sing a cozy song about a rainy evening.

prompt_templates.title: Personal Work Song
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that uses recent work context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Have my buddy sing about what I worked on today. Ask before using private memory files.

prompt_templates.title: Specific Style Song
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with genre and mood constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Make my buddy sing a fast synth-pop celebration song with playful lyrics from the pet perspective.

prompt_templates.title: Regenerated Voice Session
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that changes the cached vocal identity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Regenerate my buddy voice, then create a gentle lullaby in Japanese with full lyrics preview first.

output_examples.input: Let my buddy sing a rainy day song.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the buddy profile, creates a warm vocal identity, previews complete original lyrics, and generates a saved MP3.

output_examples.input: Sing about what I finished today.
output_examples.output: The skill checks recent session or project context, builds a pet-perspective recap song, asks for confirmation, and starts music generation.

output_examples.input: Change the voice and make it a funk song.
output_examples.output: The skill refreshes the cached voice description, applies the funk style request, previews the lyrics, and saves the generated audio file.

best_practices: Review the full lyrics and prompt preview before confirming generation.
Use clear theme, language, and style requests for better music direction.
Avoid personal context mode unless the song needs private session details.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to recreate copyrighted lyrics or imitate a living artist exactly.
Do not let it scan memory files when a simple standalone theme is enough.
Do not place secrets, API keys, or private customer data in song prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates an original song for a Claude Code buddy and saves it as an audio file.

faq.question: Does it need a MiniMax account?
faq.answer: Yes. The mmx CLI must be installed and authenticated with a MiniMax API key.

faq.question: Does it read private files?
faq.answer: It reads Claude buddy configuration and may read memory files when personal context is requested.

faq.question: Can I choose the genre?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can apply a requested genre, mood, language, or theme.

faq.question: Can the buddy keep the same voice?
faq.answer: Yes. It caches a vocal identity so the same buddy can sound consistent across sessions.

faq.question: Where are generated songs saved?
faq.answer: The skill saves generated MP3 files under the local Music folder in a MiniMax generation directory.
